scope: Complete local customers.csv, products.csv and all discovered transaction CSV files; no source modifications or network access.
limitations: Current dimension snapshots do not provide historical ownership or currency-validity intervals; mismatches are cross-file inconsistencies, not proof of fraudulent transactions.
Counts include exact duplicate source rows; duplicate and conflicting IDs are reported separately.
Rows without checked issues is not a production-ready cohort: it precedes retrospective quarantine of every row with a conflicting transaction ID and excludes unchecked policy/business rules.
No complaint records, evaluation final set, source policies, model performance, or real banking action APIs were inspected by this script.
